study_protocol.objective: Measure true PPO throughput at8192 environments and scale fast-particle Franka Pour training toward resource limits on one L40 and the local RTX PRO6000.
study_protocol.checkpoint_note: 6997 was the cached baseline originally used. User pointed out7450; strict CPU actor/critic/optimizer loading passed and new matched groups use7450. Historical6997 and contaminated/interrupted runs remain separate.
study_protocol.source_digest_framing: Sorted *.py relative path, NUL, raw file bytes, NUL.
study_protocol.primary_metric: 480 * num_envs / synchronized runner.learn wall time, including optimization/logging/checkpoint save; excludes process setup and preceding warmup/inference.
study_protocol.capacity_bracket_protocol: May use1PPO iteration and16preceding inference steps; label capacity-only, confirm highest candidate with primary5iteration protocol.
study_protocol.local_gpu_contention_policy: User explicitly requested waiting for other work to finish; no unrelated process may be interrupted. Abort only our contaminated attempt, preserve it as timing-ineligible, require5continuous idle minutes before retry.
interpretation_limits: More environments change PPO batch/minibatch sizes and reset episode populations.
Final finite states can follow automatic resets; they are not a complete stability or policy quality guarantee.
Original7450 training task/material configuration is absent from the downloaded checkpoint folder.
Largest completed batch and highest observed throughput are different quantities.
Host-safety stops and checkpoint-steering interruptions are not CUDA out-of-memory failures.
